__comment: Phase-3c Cutover-Day Live-Stream Grafana panel-subset (Noa Bergstroem / SRE, Tag-41). Extends the Tag-40 phase-3c-cross-welle-coordination dashboard (71 panels, PR #260) with seven realtime panels driven by the Tag-41 cutover-day-live-stream-aggregator.py output (wakir_cutover_live_* Prometheus gauges). Mounted as a separate dashboard rather than re-emitting the 71-panel parent so the Cutover-Tag-Morgen operator can open ONE focused view at 06:30 CEST instead of scrolling 71 panels. Panels: (1) Realtime BackendDecision distribution per active Welle (multi-line graph, one Welle per series), (2) per-Welle live tail of the last 60s of decisions (stat-counter), (3) Cross-Welle-Drift indicator grid (RED/AMBER/GREEN heat per Welle-pair), (4) Drift-band-crossing count over 1h (RED + AMBER), (5) per-Welle backend-decision latency histogram (p50/p95/p99 timeseries), (6) Active-Welle inventory (stat: count of Wellen with sample_count > 0), (7) Mira-Notify queue depth (count of RED-crossing events not yet acked by operator-runbook). Schema version Grafana 10.x (schemaVersion 38). Sole datasource UID 'prom' (Prometheus). Anchor: ADR-0066 Phase-3c Cutover-Plan Welle-1..7, Tag-41 Live-Stream-Aggregator + Cross-Welle-Drift-Live-Indicator.
title: Wakir - Phase-3c Cutover-Day Live-Stream

panels.title: Realtime BackendDecision-Distribution per Welle (live tail)
panels.__comment: Multi-line graph: one line per (welle, outcome) tuple, value is the fraction in [0,1] of the sliding window currently classified as that outcome. The Cutover-Tag-Morgen operator watches whether production-fraction stays > 0.95 on each active Welle (pre-cutover baseline) and whether shadow / fallback fractions remain near-zero. Source gauge: wakir_cutover_live_distribution from Tag-41 cutover-day-live-stream-aggregator.py. Per-Welle filtering via the $welle templating variable.

panels.title: Sliding-Window Sample Count per Welle (live tail)
panels.__comment: Per-Welle stat-counter showing the number of BackendDecision events in the active sliding window. Default window 300 events; a Welle with sample_count near 300 is at-capacity and the rollups are fully representative. A Welle with sample_count < 30 has too few samples for the drift indicator to be trustworthy (the operator-runbook calls this out). Source gauge: wakir_cutover_live_sample_count.

panels.title: Cross-Welle-Drift Indicator (RED/AMBER/GREEN per Welle-Pair)
panels.__comment: Heatmap of pairwise total-variation drift between every two active Welle distributions. Y axis: welle_a; X axis: welle_b; cell value: drift in [0,1]. Threshold bands GREEN < 0.05, AMBER < 0.15, RED >= 0.15 (operator-tuned defaults in Tag-41 aggregator). The Doppel-Welle KW-26 pair (welle-4 state_backing + welle-5 lifecycle_state_machine, ADR-0066 Mitigation-1) is the highest-risk cell during KW-26 — the on-stream A7-test (ADR-0066 §Mitigation-2-Cross-Welle-Coordination-Test). Source gauge: wakir_cutover_live_drift.

panels.title: Drift-Band-Crossing Count over 1h (RED + AMBER)
panels.__comment: Timeseries of the two drift-band-crossing counters over the last hour. wakir_cutover_live_drift_red is the count of Welle-pairs currently in the RED band; wakir_cutover_live_drift_amber the AMBER band. A non-zero RED line is the Mira-Notify-trigger; the Bash-wrapper greps DRIFT_RED_CROSSING on the aggregator stdout and forwards to notify queue (docs/observability/cutover-day-watch-runbook.md). An AMBER line crossing into RED within 5 minutes is the cutover-pause-threshold.

panels.title: BackendDecision-Latency Histogram per Welle (p50/p95/p99 Realtime)
panels.__comment: Per-Welle BackendDecision-latency percentile timeseries. p50 / p95 / p99 lines per active Welle. Pre-cutover baseline target: p99 < 25ms across all active Wellen (Tag-38 SLI). A p99 spike correlated with a backend-distribution shift towards 'fallback' is the canonical cutover-failure signature. Source gauge: wakir_cutover_live_latency_ms.

panels.title: Active-Welle Inventory (Wellen with > 0 samples)
panels.__comment: Single-stat: count of Wellen the aggregator has seen at least one event from in the current run. During Doppel-Welle KW-26 this should read 2 (welle-4 + welle-5 active). During Solo-Welle KW-25 this should read 1 (welle-3). A value of 0 means the BackendDecision-stream is silent (operator-runbook §Stream-Silent-Investigation). A value > 2 means an unexpected Welle is in-flight outside the cutover-plan (operator-runbook §Unexpected-Welle-Activation).

panels.title: Mira-Notify Queue Depth (un-acked RED-Crossings)
panels.__comment: Single-stat counter of RED-band Welle-pairs currently active. Maps to the Bash-wrapper notify-log: each DRIFT_RED_CROSSING line waits for operator-runbook ack. Anything > 0 is a live cutover-pause condition. Source gauge: wakir_cutover_live_drift_red (the same gauge as panel 4, but with stat presentation for the top-of-dashboard at-a-glance check). The operator-runbook docs/observability/cutover-day-watch-runbook.md §Notify-Ack walks through the ack procedure.
